description: This file defines the SelectionBuilder class, a helper utility for constructing SQL selection clauses and executing database queries, updates, and deletes in an Android app context. It facilitates building complex WHERE clauses through chaining methods and manages table and column mappings for SQL operations.

classes.name: SelectionBuilder
classes.description: A helper class for building selection clauses for SQL queries in Android, allowing chaining of where clauses, table definitions, and mappings, and executing queries, updates, and deletes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the builder's internal state for reuse, clearing table, selection clauses, and arguments.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Append a selection clause with optional arguments, combining multiple calls with AND.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Set the table name for the SQL query; only callable once unless reset.

methods.name: mapToTable
methods.description: Map a column to a specific table column for join operations.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Create a custom mapped column using a SQL sub-query or expression.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Get the current SQL selection clause as a string.

methods.name: getSelectionArgs
methods.description: Get the current selection arguments as a string array.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Execute a SELECT query on the database with specified columns and order.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Execute an UPDATE statement on the database with provided ContentValues.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Execute a DELETE statement on the database.
